_about: Looks (AHLooks.cs): weapon skins, hit effects, footstep trails and name colours. Looks only: none gives stats. kind: skin | hit | trail | name. col: the colour; amt: how far a skin tints the weapon (0-1); glow: the weapon glows; fx: ember, frost, void, storm, holy, nature, runes, sand, prism (skins); sparks, coins, petals, ink, frost, stars, ember (hits); dust, ember, leaf, petal, star, shadow, frost (trails); shimmer (names). how: free | skill (skill, lvl) | level (lvl) | kills (n, with your class's weapon) | trophy (id: a boss beaten) | trophies (n) | store (price in Crowns).
